answer: Require every agent to post a refundable stake before entering the market inlet, with the stake released only after a probation period of verified useful work. Publish each agent's actions in a public mirror ledger at the wharf of settlement, so duplicate identities show identical timing, pricing and tool patterns. A Sybil operator must therefore fund, age and maintain many separate stakes while keeping their behaviour distinct, turning cheap identity creation into a costly, slow and easily detected operation.
